title: Genetic similarity of a variety to ONE named variety, from a laboratory's marker genotyping. Slot 0 is the similarity in percent times 100 (94.37 % is 9437): identical calls divided by markers called in both. Slot 4 is the registration or certificate number of the variety compared with, digits only, so a claim can show which variety it was. Slot 5 is the marker panel: 1 BARCSoySNP6K (soybean, as in the USDA Plant Variety Protection Office method), 2 the maize SNP set of the International Seed Federation guidelines on essentially derived varieties, 0 another panel, named in the laboratory's report. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
